261174572_47e0f8ee.text: DMH neuron types were selected on the basis of previously reported markers (Lee et al., 2012), as well as known highly expressed genes in the DMH including Lepr, Pdyn, Ppp1r17, Cck, and Grp (Çağlar et al., 2021)(Defalco et al., 2001)(Imoto et al., 2021). Markers were validated via the Allen Brain Atlas mouse in situ hybridization data. In addition, clusters enriched with genes expressed in surrounding hypothalamic regions but not DMH were excluded from further analysis, including the following: paraventricular nucleus of hypothalamus (PVH) (Sim1) (Michaud et al., 2001), ventromedial hypothalamus (VMH) (Slit3, Qrfpr, Arpp21, Nr5a1, and Fezf1) (106), ARC (Prlr and Nr5a2) (107), lateral hypothalamus (LH) (Pvalb, Klk6, and Nts) (Mészár et al., 2012)(Mickelsen et al., 2019), or the tuberomammillary nucleus (Hdc) (Panula et al., 1984), (Watanabe et al., 1983). Cluster markers were prioritized on the basis of multiple comparison adjusted P values, high percent expression within the cluster, and low percent expression outside of the cluster.
